Example Forensic Suite is distributed as a self-contained desktop build for Windows x64,
delivering the complete toolset in a ready-to-run package.

## ✅ Requirements
- **OS:** Windows 10 / 11
- **Shell:** PowerShell 5.1+
- **Network:** internet access to download the setup script
